resources.string: Android client for a PC host
Before you continue: a PC is required

DeepSeek Harness does not currently provide an official way to install or run Harness locally on Android.

This independently developed, unofficial LAN client only connects to and controls a Windows PC that is already running DeepSeek Harness. It cannot run Harness independently on a phone or tablet.

The Android device and PC must be on the same trusted private network. LAN mode currently has no login protection.
A Windows PC already running DeepSeek Harness is required. This app cannot run Harness independently on Android. Use only on a trusted private network; LAN mode currently has no login protection.
